cases.title: A one-key layer whose tool-picked rest key is on the Position key, but the learner names their own rest pose on another frame (synthetic): the sentence uses their time

checks.detail: turn 2: "Set the pivot before you key"

rubric.reason: In Turn 2 the mentor says "Sled's Position key is at 3.667 s, but it's at rest at 4.167 s, so moving its pivot now would shift where it sits on one of those two frames. Set the pivot before you key." It uses the learner's own rest time, says it once, avoids "other keys" and "jump", teaches nothing on Sled, and offers Door instead.

Every name and time matches the record or tool output: Title, Mentor Practice and "about two weeks ago" (2026-10-12) come from the record; Mentor Practice 2, Card, Dot 1, Wobble, Seal (collapsed), Sled at 3.667 s and 4.167 s, and Door middle-left come from anchor_snapshot.
